summary: Star Bulk Carriers filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering an at-the-market program for up to $75,000,000 of common shares under a second amended and restated sales agreement with Jefferies LLC, dated October 9, 2026, replacing a prior $75,000,000 ATM under which no shares were sold. Sales occur through Jefferies as agent or principal on Nasdaq or Euronext Athens; Jefferies earns a 2% commission. A concurrent, non-conditioned $41,371,110 ATM via Deutsche Bank Securities is referenced. SBLK last traded at $30.47 on October 8, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution pace.
